about:
Brigade Packaging operates from its headquarters in Jersey City, New Jersey, with an additional office in Dover, Delaware. The company ships products from warehouses on both the West Coast in California and the East Coast in New Jersey to serve customers across the United States. No founding year or ownership details are publicly disclosed.

The company functions as a wholesale packaging supplier, offering a broad catalog of glass, plastic, metal, and paper containers. Its product range includes vials, bottles, jars, tubes, bags, wraps, labels, and closures for pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, cosmetic, and specialty markets. Brigade Packaging does not manufacture these items but sources and distributes them in bulk, targeting small and medium-sized businesses with volume pricing.

Brigade Packaging serves industries such as pharmaceuticals, nutraceuticals, beauty and cosmetics, CBD and essential oils, food and beverages, body and skincare, cleaning and industrial, haircare, candles, hand sanitizers, e-liquids, and pet care. Its customer base includes pharmacies, laboratories, product manufacturers, distributors, veterinary clinics, and retailers.

The company emphasizes bi-coastal warehousing for rapid order fulfillment and wholesale pricing that reduces costs on bulk purchases. It also offers custom packaging and labeling services to meet specific branding or compliance needs.
